notes.type_correctness: GameState.phase union extended correctly to include 'intro'. createGameState() returns 'intro'. updateGameState() intro guard is correctly ordered before gameover guard. All TypeScript compilation clean.

No dedicated SplashScreen unit tests — SplashScreen has PixiJS/WebGL dependencies that would require mocking. The visual behavior is covered by manual smoke test checklist in the spec.
notes.security: No network I/O, no eval, no untrusted input. GlowFilter wrapped in try/catch for Canvas 2D fallback — correct defensive pattern.

Splash is destroyed on intro→playing transition (not just hidden), keeping the scene graph clean. splashContainer is added to stage before modalContainer, respecting render order.
